lesson.title: 5.1 Fruits
lesson.unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
lesson.goal: Recognize and name six fruits and fruit itself, and describe them with known colors, numbers and family members.
lesson.grammar_function: a/an + fruit; It is a pear. They are grapes. The apple is green. Three oranges. The baby is eating a banana.
lesson.prerequisite: 1.2-1.4 eating, baby, children; 2.6-2.8 numbers and colors; 4.3 on.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Name the fruit in a picture and say what a family member is eating.
